A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FW-Merging work. All 14 pages of each version, including Appendices A and B, are readable, and their equations, experiments, tables, and figures can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original vision and language experiments, scaling tests, ablations, and data-efficiency results in Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–5.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical experiments and appendix results, with a revised generative-task score in Table 1.

M1.justification: The hard/soft FW procedures, model selection, coefficient optimization, merging functions, and task/layer-wise variants remain unchanged. v3 describes the objective more generally and removes explicit dataset arguments from most formulas and Algorithm 1, but specifies no new implemented loss or algorithmic component.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 20 vision tasks, eight GLUE checkpoints, 16 generative-language checkpoints, and evaluation datasets. Relevant-model, irrelevant-model, and noisy-model scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding experiments. Tables 1–4 retain the same MTL and merging comparisons, including Task Arithmetic, Ties, DARE, AdaMerging, and the additional vision baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix B.3 changes the reported vision FWsoft budget from 5 to 15 iterations. Section 4.1 already specified 15 in v1, so this resolves a reporting inconsistency without establishing that experiments were rerun. Splits, metrics, model configurations, and scaling-experiment budgets otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The design and coefficient ablations in Table 5, initialization and merging-function analyses in Figure 4, relevance and noisy-model analyses, and Appendix A's data-efficiency comparison are retained without additional analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The retained tables and plots continue to report point estimates.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes FWhard's generative-task score from 80.8 to 81.1 under the same described setting. Section 4.2 updates its margins over Task Arithmetic, Ties, and Ties with DARE from 4.9/2.3/34.2 to 5.2/2.6/34.5. However, Section 4.3 still reports 80.8 and the table's aggregate remains 83.1. Other reported results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Propositions 1–2, Theorem 1, their assumptions, proofs, and convergence bound remain substantively unchanged. Suppressing the dataset argument in the loss notation introduces no new mathematical result or correction to the reasoning.

C1.justification: The central claims about scalable merging, robustness to irrelevant or noisy models, constant memory overhead, compatibility with existing merging methods, and data efficiency are retained. The abstract's deleted explanation of the objective and constraint set remains elsewhere in the paper.

C2.justification: Section 3.2 broadens the explanation of allowable objectives from a training-dataset multitask loss to goal-specific losses, explicitly including alignment of merged and individual models. Appendix A now explicitly identifies its data-efficiency comparison as a language benchmark. Other mechanism explanations and feasibility qualifications remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B.3 corrects the vision FWsoft iteration count and removes the explicit 100-sample count from its vision-sampling sentence. Section 4.1 still contains a 100-sample dataset list, so a changed vision sample size is not established. Code and checkpoint links and the remaining implementation details are retained.

R1.justification: Section 3.2 newly connects its objective formulation to model alignment in existing reference [63] and task objectives in [69]. This is a limited addition to positioning; the related-work survey and the set of 73 references otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Changes include shortening the abstract, revising the objective explanation and dataset notation, clarifying Appendix A's benchmark scope, adding an ICCV acceptance footnote, and replacing the acknowledgements. The section hierarchy and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: All five figures and five tables are retained. v3 adjusts table spacing and rules, removes page-number footers, and reflows text and appendices; Figure 5 moves from PDF page 12 to page 13. Figure 1's caption drops its Appendix B.4 pointer. There is no substantial visual redesign.

improvement.justification: v3 resolves the 5-versus-15 iteration inconsistency between Appendix B.3 and Section 4.1, improving reproducibility documentation. However, its revised 81.1 score conflicts with the unchanged 80.8 in Section 4.3, while Table 1's aggregate remains 83.1. This clarification and new reporting inconsistency provide opposing quality effects whose net direction cannot be reliably established from the PDFs.
